issues.actual: Two fixture tests error during tracker ownership validation because the test input already contains the atexit owner.
issues.evidence: recoil_provider_function_mutation_tests.ProviderFunctionMutationTests.test_atexit_dry_run_proves_exact_archive_member_without_mutation and test_apply_updates_only_fixture_and_revision_guards both raise ProviderFunctionMutationError: function extent is overlapping or already owned for provider.vc5_crt.atexit.
issues.expected: The fixture presents an unowned synthetic range so the tests reach and verify exact archive-member dry-run/apply behavior.
issues.impact: doctor --quick --binja reports an infrastructure failure even though the Binary Ninja bridge and reconstruction checks pass; two provider mutation tests fail before exercising their intended dry-run/apply behavior.
issues.next_action: Update only the provider-function mutation fixture/setup so its synthetic atexit registration does not overlap already-owned tracker entries, preserving production mutation semantics and revision guards.
issues.repro: Run python tools/recoil.py doctor --quick --binja; all checks pass except Python tool tests, specifically recoil_provider_function_mutation_tests.py with two overlap errors.
issues.summary: Provider-function mutation fixture no longer isolates atexit ownership
issues.workaround: Run the focused call-contract verifier and Binary Ninja bridge checks independently; the defect is unrelated to current reconstruction evidence.

issues.actual: _bindings includes linked_function_intervals using target.source_from even when it is empty. _select_bindings then selects that row, _compare_row resolves the repository root as its source, and safe_object_stem raises ValueError: WindowsPath('.') has an empty name.
issues.expected: The byte verifier should select only target entries that identify an actual compilation source; source-less linked-order registrations must remain available to order validation but must not become object-byte candidates or matched-group byte bindings.
issues.impact: advance-live-byte crashes after a fresh whole-project build while revalidating accepted 0x401000 because an added linked-only order target has no source_from; this prevents governed acceptance of already-matched 0x401d50.
issues.next_action: Exclude source-less linked-only verification registrations from object/authored byte TargetBinding candidates while still failing closed when a scope has no source-backed byte target; add focused prefix and matched-group tests.
issues.summary: authored-byte prefix scan treats source-less linked-order targets as object-byte bindings
issues.workaround: Focused --at 0x401d50 validation passes because that function has only a source-backed AINet binding, but parent acceptance must revalidate the accepted prefix and cannot bypass 0x401000.

issues.actual: The v4 negative-control payload accepts only section lengths plus raw_fold_relevant_bytes_equal, relocation_partitions_equal, and associative_sections_equal. It rejects a control when all of those are equal and comdat_eligible is true, even when VC5 COFF auxiliary metadata proves IMAGE_COMDAT_SELECT_ANY for the distinct base control versus IMAGE_COMDAT_SELECT_NODUPLICATES for both folded authored members.
issues.evidence: build/reconstruction-evidence/runs/0x42ee40-inline-icf-r2626/paired-icf.map; build/reconstruction-evidence/runs/0x42ee40-inline-icf-r2626/paired-noicf.map; VC5 COFF inventories for RecoilApp.obj, zui.obj, and hud.obj.
issues.expected: The governed v4 proof contract should encode exact member/control COMDAT selection values and treat a verified selection mismatch as a fold-relevant difference, while preserving fail-closed exact fields and existing retail/candidate separation.
issues.impact: A source-faithful VC5 model that exactly reproduces the retail ICF partition cannot be registered without falsely claiming a byte, relocation, associative-section, or COMDAT-eligibility difference.
issues.next_action: Extend the canonical authored-ICF v4 negative-control proof with exact member/control COMDAT selection metadata, focused parser/audit tests, and procedure documentation; keep prior v4 payloads either compatible or migrate fixtures explicitly.
issues.repro: Use recoil-logical-alias-group-v4 for physical 0x42ee40 with identical 16-byte zero-relocation members and base control. Current-source VC5 objects prove member selection 1/noduplicates and base selection 2/any; paired links over the exact same object inputs split members under /OPT:NOICF, fold the two members under /OPT:ICF, and keep the base distinct. validate_authored_icf_proof still has no truthful field that demonstrates the selection mismatch.
issues.summary: Authored-ICF v4 cannot encode a negative control distinguished only by COMDAT selection
issues.workaround: None. Do not falsify an existing comparison boolean or mark the COMDAT control ineligible.
